title: StudioBrain Taxonomy File
description: A controlled vocabulary shipped as pure data. Drop *.yaml in taxonomies/. Axes group terms; each term carries the prompt phrase that is substituted into its axis hypothesis_template to build the candidate text a zero-shot model scores. `content_hash` stamps the canonical form of the axes block so a precomputed embedding artifact can prove it is not stale.

revision.description: Human-facing semver. Bump minor when terms are added, major when an existing term id changes meaning or is removed.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the axes block (each term reduced to {id, prompt}, with axis order AND term order preserved -- the artifact stores one vector per label in exactly that order, so a reordering must move the hash). Recomputed and enforced by scripts/validate.py; a precomputed embedding artifact must carry the same value or it is stale.

axes.description: Axis id -> axis. Axis order and term order are significant: a precomputed embedding artifact stores one vector per label in exactly this order.

hypothesis_template.description: Candidate-text template containing exactly one '{}' placeholder. The term's `prompt` carries its own article/inflection so one template stays grammatical across the axis.

id.description: Bare tag written into assets.tags. Kept snake_case and stable -- the tags filter is a case-sensitive JSON LIKE match.

prompt.description: Phrase substituted into the axis hypothesis_template to form the candidate text that is actually embedded.
